procedure.method: In this fresh independent critic session I verified the supplied file hashes and byte sizes and read packet.json, case.json, the pinned rules/rubric, the declared ratio policy, summarize.py, run_agent.py and the five pinned native-evidence manifests. I did not follow unlisted paths embedded in those manifests. The packet supplies no source assets or protected layouts. I then used tools.view_image via functions.exec in five member-ordered calls: M1, M2, M3, M4, M5. Within each call I awaited native, usage720 and thumbnail320 in that order and emitted each returned exact image with detail original. I inspected all fifteen displayed image outputs before the first transcription judgment or image/set score. The ordered viewed list records those exact paths/hashes, not a claim about runner trace event serialization. The PNG IHDR bytes independently confirm all native dimensions as 1024x1536, RGB color type 2. First copy reads and subsequent normalized comparisons are preserved separately from layout. No genuine glyph/punctuation ambiguity required a revisit. I did not generate/edit images, inspect peer/maker records, spawn/fork/resume, or claim an observable runtime thread ID; the runner owns provenance.
